output.reason: [ev-ab4bd1639399] lists this under Bug or Regression. It says only that a Certificate being deleted will no longer create CertificateRequest or Secret objects. It does not say anything fails, is rejected or needs migrating, so a low-severity behavior-change (review) is the right kind. However, the proposed statement adds "spurious resource creation in the finalizer cleanup phase", which the evidence does not support, so I limited the statement to what the release note says.

correction.statement: From cert-manager 1.17.0, a Certificate that is being deleted no longer creates CertificateRequest or Secret objects (bug fix). Nothing fails; the controller behaves differently during deletion.

consequence.statement: While a Certificate is being deleted, cert-manager no longer creates CertificateRequest or Secret objects for it. Before this release it could create them during deletion.
